channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: Cross River Adds Ripple USD to Its Banking Platform
item.description: Cross River is adding Ripple USD on the XRP Ledger to its banking platform, giving fintechs one API for stablecoin settlement alongside ACH, wires and real-time payments.

item.title: Why Bridge Pools Pay Out Before Inventory Rebalances
item.description: A bridge can deliver destination tokens before source funds arrive; relayers, pool accounting and later rebalancing explain how inventory and risk move.

item.title: A Cross-Chain Swap Failed. What Should You Check Before Retrying?
item.description: A failed cross-chain swap can mean a reverted deposit, a delayed message or a failed payout; check the on-chain state before sending funds again.

item.title: Keep Native SOL Available for a Swap After Bridging
item.description: A bridged token does not pay Solana fees: keep native SOL for the fee payer, possible token-account creation and failed swap attempts.

item.title: Why Your Crypto Left One Chain but Hasn’t Arrived
item.description: A confirmed source transaction proves only that a bridge accepted the request; follow its message or fill record, then verify the destination transaction and token.

item.title: Ledger details CryptoBilis implant as MediaMarkt halts sales
item.description: Ledger says an implant in CryptoBilis-sold signers read recovery phrases from their screens and sent them over LTE, prompting MediaMarkt Saturn to pause sales.

item.title: Set Slippage by the Swap Legs in a Cross-Chain Route
item.description: Set slippage against the swap legs in a cross-chain route, then verify the destination minimum, bridge quote, fees and failure path before signing.

item.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow consensus switch for Oct. 21
item.description: Solana will activate Alpenglow in epoch 1064 on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT’s vote transactions with direct validator certificates and targeting 150ms finality.

item.title: Acrossbridge: How Cross-Chain Transfers and Swaps Work
item.description: Acrossbridge combines a source-chain transfer with destination delivery and, when needed, a token swap; the route depends on liquidity, verification and finality.

item.title: What Is quickswap? How Cross-Chain Swaps Settle
item.description: A cross-chain swap coordinates a source-chain trade, asset transfer and destination-chain settlement; quickswap provides one flow for moving and swapping assets.

item.title: FinCEN withdraws Section 311 crypto mixing proposal
item.description: FinCEN withdrew its 2023 Section 311 proposal on international crypto mixing, removing planned reporting duties while keeping its authority to monitor illicit finance.

item.title: Binance rolls out AI interface after 150,000-user beta
item.description: Binance opened its AI interface to English-language users after a beta with about 150,000 testers, adding personalized market context, alerts and portfolio summaries.

item.title: XRPL fixes payment overflow that could mint trillions of XRP
item.description: XRPL’s 3.4.1 release fixed an unchecked payment overflow that could create spendable XRP, taking effect on server upgrade to limit the time a public exploit remained open.

item.title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in device tied to CryptoBilis losses
item.description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized implant in one affected device as investigators estimated more than $86 million in suspected wallet losses across three chains.

item.title: FinCEN drops proposed crypto mixing rule
item.description: FinCEN has withdrawn its 2023 mixer rule proposal after commenters warned its broad definition could chill lawful privacy use and burden financial institutions.

item.title: Ether ETF outflows reach nine days as Solana streak ends
item.description: U.S. spot Ether ETFs lost $542.1 million last week as nine days of redemptions continued, while Solana funds recorded their first weekly outflow in 14 weeks.

item.title: Ledger probes CryptoBilis wallet reports; $86M estimate unverified
item.description: Ledger has asked CryptoBilis to stop shipments as it probes reported wallet drains; an investigator's $86 million estimate remains unverified, and buyers are told to act.

item.title: Samsung adds USDC remittances to Galaxy Wallet
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet for eligible U.S. Galaxy users in October, reaching crypto wallets or bank accounts in more than 60 countries.

item.title: Cardano puts programmable token standard CIP-0113 on mainnet
item.description: Cardano Foundation says CIP-0113 is live on mainnet, letting issuers attach modular compliance checks to native assets that the ledger validates on each operation.

item.title: Fairshake Names 32 House Incumbents for Midterm Spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the CLARITY Act remains stalled ahead of November's midterms.
